name: What regulations or standards apply to slip-resistant flooring in commercial spaces in California?

mainEntity.name: What regulations or standards apply to slip-resistant flooring in commercial spaces in California?

acceptedAnswer.text: Commercial spaces in California, particularly those serving the public or with employees, often need to comply with various safety standards related to flooring. These can include OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) guidelines, local building codes, and accessibility standards like the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), which includes requirements for surface traction in certain areas. Specific industries may also have their own regulations. While there isn't one universal 'slip-resistant' standard for all scenarios, ensuring a high Coefficient of Friction (COF) and proper floor selection is key. We ensure our installations meet or exceed applicable safety and building codes for your specific application.
acceptedAnswer.description: Commercial flooring in California must comply with OSHA guidelines, local building codes, and ADA requirements. Specific industry regulations may also apply.
